findings.source: DepositContractBase.sol:81-104 _addLeaf: node = leaf; for (height < 32) { if (((size >> height) & 1) == 1) { _branch[height] = node; return; } node = efficientKeccak256(_branch[height], node); } assert(false); :129-150 calculateRoot
findings.issue: The Merkle node is carried as its difference from the initial leaf hash (s = node - leaf, starting at 0), so the 300-character leaf expression is printed three times per loop and every iteration reads 'sha3(..., s + leaf) - leaf'. The text is exact (the offsets cancel), but the recurrence node = keccak(branch[h], node) is unrecognisable; the loops whose initial value is a plain variable (getRoot, the second calculateRoot loop 't = s') print naturally.
findings.rule: Normalise a loop-carried variable to an offset from its initial value only when its update is affine in it (v = v + c); for any other recurrence keep v itself with its initial value (node = leaf; node = sha3(stor[t + 51], node)).
findings.verified: reading only (the cancellation s + leaf - leaf is exact modulo 2^256)

findings.rule: When both arms of an if write the same scratch words that the join hashes and nothing else reads, print 'sha3(a, b)' with the arm-specific a and b (a select), as for a single-arm write; print every 'stor[i + N]' access to a fixed array at slot N as storN[i].
